## Purpose of This Site

Hello! I'm **Matteo Aldovardi**, a mathematics graduate (University of Pisa) with a 1-year Master's in Mathematical and Physical Methods for Engineering from the University of Turin (UniTO), currently enrolled in the Data Engineering program at Politecnico di Torino. 

This site serves as my personal blog and portfolio, where I document my exploration of data engineering, machine learning, AI, and mathematics, sharing insights, implementations, and projects along the way. Check out my [**Portfolio**](portfolio.qmd) for applied industry projects (such as 3D computer vision at Leonardo Velivoli) and academic publications, or explore my [**Blog**](blog/index.qmd) for technical walkthroughs.
